body:
If you're a designer, go beyond making it look pretty — learn how to develop brand strategy from the ground up with my list of top strategy courses. In 2026, the demand for designers who can think strategically has never been higher, making these skills essential for career growth.

If you're a consultant who is onboarding a new client and you don't take the time to understand the business behind it, the target audience, the appropriate tone of voice and messaging, then you're just doing disservice to your client. Taking shortcuts early in the process almost always leads to misaligned deliverables and frustrated stakeholders down the line.

Similarly if you're an entrepreneur who dismiss brand strategy and jumps straight into logo & brand identity design, then will most likely end up confused, not even mentioning potential business failure. A strong strategic foundation ensures every visual decision supports your business goals and resonates with your target market.

What is the goal of brand strategy?

The goal of brand strategy is to focus all your visual, verbal and conceptual thinking on design solutions that will help you client achieve your business and marketing objectives. It transforms subjective design decisions into objective, measurable outcomes that drive real business results.

That's why you need to get clarity on key aspects of branding in order to be able to make decisions that are "on brand". This clarity becomes your north star for every creative decision you make throughout the project.

Here's my list of the top 17 best courses to learn brand strategy online (developed by top brand strategists). I've personally reviewed each course and selected only those that deliver practical, actionable knowledge you can apply immediately.

Best Brand Strategy Courses:

  1. Brand Strategy Guide by Arek Dvornechuck
  2. WHY Discovery by Simon Sinek
  3. StoryBrand by Donald Miller
  4. Designing Strategy by IDEO U
  5. Strategy Sprint by Scott Galloway
  6. Brand Strategy Class by Mark Pollard
  7. Introduction To Brand Strategy by Alejandro Pascalis
  8. Brand Strategy for Online Platforms by James Eccleston
  9. Brand Strategy: Defining User Experience by John Williamson
  10. Client-Centered Brand Strategy by Thiago Delfino

  13. Brand Master Academy Course Review

  16. Product Deign Strategy by Future London Academy
  17. Brand Strategy Academy by Sarah Robb

PS. Also check out my list of other resources on brand strategy (books, podcasts, blogs etc.)

What is brand strategy

Brand strategy is basically bridging the gap between the business and design. It's the critical thinking layer that ensures your creative work serves a purpose beyond aesthetics.

Brand strategy is the foundation for building a strong brand.

Your goal as a brand strategist is to go above and beyond just making your brand look pretty — you need to make it work. This means understanding market dynamics, customer psychology, and competitive positioning before touching any design software.

Developing brand strategy will help you learn as much about the business as possible, so that you can propose the best possible creative solutions. The more you understand about your client's challenges and opportunities, the more impactful your work becomes.

But if you don't go into your project with some sort of a strategy, you will most likely get a lot of push back from your client. Without strategic rationale, every design decision becomes a battle of personal preferences rather than informed choices.

And you and your clients will be very subjective, saying something like: "I don't like blue" — then it becomes a very difficult conversation. Strategy gives you the language and framework to move past subjective opinions toward objective solutions.

So when you don't do the strategy it becomes very subjective and more of an art critique. This wastes time, erodes trust, and often leads to mediocre results that satisfy no one.

That's why business solutions that have both rationale and creative parts at their core are essential to differentiating you and your work from the pack. In 2026, clients expect strategic thinking as standard—not a premium add-on.

So without further ado — let's look at some of the best brand strategy courses available online.

1. Brand Strategy Kit by Arek Dvonerchuck

I humbly feature my own brand strategy course as the first best branding course on my list. After years of client work, I've distilled my most effective frameworks into this comprehensive resource.

This course teaches you the best techniques I have learned in the past 20 years of branding.

My Brand Strategy Kit offers a comprehensive guide to mastering brand strategy and advancing your career with practical tools I use daily with my clients at Ebaqdesign. Everything included has been battle-tested with real clients across various industries.

Cost: $199 | Length: 2 hours 45 min | By: Arek Dvonerchuck

This kit includes an 89-page guidebook, 13 video tutorials, and fillable worksheets that you can customize for your agency. The materials are designed to be white-labeled so you can present them professionally to your own clients.

It has step-by-step guidance for both in-person and remote workshops, along with a facilitator's script and presentation templates. Whether you're conducting discovery sessions virtually or in a boardroom, you'll have the tools to lead with confidence.

You also get access to a Book of Prompts for AI chatbots like ChatGPT, that can help you with your branding. These prompts have been refined throughout 2026 to leverage the latest AI capabilities for brand research and ideation.

I highly recommend this course for logo designers, studio owners, freelancers, brand strategists, creative directors, entrepreneurs, marketers, web designers, and students. It's designed to meet you where you are and help you level up your strategic capabilities.

Check out this video tutorial on youtube, which is a preview of me running one of the branding exercises.

If you're looking for a brand strategy course with expert knowledge, the Brand Strategy Kit is the perfect choice for you.

2. WHY Discovery Course by Simon Sinek

Simon Sinek is the author of the bestselling book Start With Why and the more practical version Find Your Why — a written version of his online course. His TED Talk remains one of the most-watched presentations on leadership and purpose.

A practical guide for discovering purpose for you and your team.

This course is designed to help you find words to express what truly inspires you. It's particularly powerful for founders and teams who sense they have something meaningful to offer but struggle to articulate it clearly.

Cost: $250 | Length: 2 hours minimum | By Simon Sinek

Simon's course is based on the concept of Golden Circle which he explains is grounded in the biology of human decision making. Understanding this framework changes how you approach every brand conversation.

This easy-to-follow guide starts with discovering your personal WHY, and then expands to articulating your organization's WHY. The personal discovery process often reveals surprising insights that translate directly into authentic brand positioning.

So whether you're a CEO or a team, these simple steps will lead you on a path to a more fulfilling life and long-term success for you and your brand. Companies with a clear purpose consistently outperform those focused solely on profit.

Over 16,000 people have become students of this course. The global community of WHY practitioners continues to grow as more organizations recognize the power of purpose-driven branding.

This online course costs only $250 and contains short and actionable videos together with worksheets to help you implement what you learn right away. The investment pays for itself the moment you can articulate your purpose to a prospective client.

I strongly recommend this course for all CEO's and teams who either start a new business/brand or go through a rebrand process. It's foundational work that should precede any visual identity development.

PS. I based the Brand Purpose exercise of my Strategy Guide on the Simon's concept of Golden Circle.

3. StoryBrand by Donald Miller

Donald Miller is a New York Times bestselling author and CEO of StoryBrand and he has helped over 10,000 businesses clarify their message. His framework has become the industry standard for brand messaging in 2026.

An online course to help you create a clear message that works.

In this course, he'll help you clarify your company's message so customers pay attention and respond. The clarity you gain translates directly into higher conversion rates and stronger customer relationships.

Cost: $275 | Length: 28 Videos, 20 hours | By Donald Miller

Donald's course is based on his proprietary storytelling framework described in more detail in his books StoryBrand and the most recent Marketing Made Simple. The framework works because it's rooted in timeless storytelling principles that resonate across cultures.

His 7-step messaging framework goes like this:

"A character who wants something encounters a problem before they can get it. At the peak of their despair, a guide steps into their lives gives them a plan, and calls them to action. That action helps them avoid failure and ends in a success."

Although this is not a typical brand strategy course but a messaging framework, it's worth mentioning because messaging is a big part of developing a sound brand strategy. In fact, many brand failures stem from unclear messaging rather than poor visual design.

You will learn how to use words to tell a compelling brand story and position your brand as a guide and solution to your customer's problems and pain points. This positioning shift—from hero to guide—is transformational for most brands.

In this course, you'll get access to a free online tool (worksheets) that guides you through the implementation process step-by-step. The tools make it easy to apply the framework immediately after completing each module.

I highly recommend this course for anyone working on website copy, email sequences and sales letters. It's also invaluable for creating pitch decks and sales presentations that convert.

PS. I based my Storytelling Guide on the Donald's StoryBrand framework.

4. Designing Strategy by IDEO U

IDEO is an award-winning global design company that created IDEO U (University) to teach the methods and mindsets they have been practicing for decades. Their human-centered design approach has shaped how the world's leading companies innovate.

A human-centered, design thinking approach to help organizations innovate and grow.

In this course, you'll learn a process that will help you create and take action on a strategy for your business, team, or organization. The methodology balances analytical rigor with creative exploration.

Cost: $799 | Length: 4 hours / week, 5 weeks | By IDEO U

The lessons in the IDEO's brand strategy course are designed to challenge assumptions and provoke new ways of working. You'll learn to see opportunities where others see obstacles.

You'll learn from esteemed practitioners who apply these methods every day in their own work. The instructors bring real-world case studies from Fortune 500 companies and ambitious startups alike.

By combining rigor and creativity, you can both analyze the world as it is and imagine how it could be better. This dual perspective is what separates good strategists from great ones.

You'll follow repeatable steps that are both human-centered and business-focused. The framework ensures you never lose sight of the people you're designing for.

The course is mainly addressed to business owners to help them with choosing what to do and what not to do. Strategic clarity often comes from knowing what to say no to.

However, also as a creative you can benefit from this course — it will teach you the process IDEO goes through with their clients, so you can use it in your creative practice.

5. The Brand Strategy Sprint by Scott Galloway

Scott Galloway is an entrepreneur, author, and renowned NYU Professor of Marketing who is known for his course called "The Brand Strategy Sprint". His sharp analysis and no-nonsense teaching style have made him one of the most sought-after business educators.

An intensive learning experience to help you understand the strategies that drive a brand's value.

‍In this course you will learn everything from how to improve a firm's value proposition to how to outmaneuver the competition. The strategic frameworks are applicable whether you're building a startup or repositioning an established brand.

Cost: $83 per month | Length: 2 weeks | By Scott Galloway.

The Brand Strategy Sprint is a two week intensive workshop done completely online. The sprint format creates urgency and momentum that accelerates learning.

You learn frameworks and step-by-step techniques to put this knowledge into practice. Every concept is immediately applicable to real business challenges.

The course focuses around 8 winning strategies of the most innovative and valuable firms in the world (case studies). You'll study what makes companies like Apple, Amazon, and Tesla so effective at brand building.

Most importantly you will learn by doing, with discussion groups, active Slack discussions, prompts, and opportunities to collaborate with peers. The cohort-based format creates accountability and networking opportunities.

What makes it different from other courses listed above is that this one (similarly to Donald's $995 option) is an interactive learning experience. You're not just watching videos—you're actively participating.

The classes are designed for mid-to-senior level professionals working full-time, whether it be CEO's and leaders, or creative professionals. The content assumes business literacy and moves quickly.

What's unique — you'll also get access to private Slack community with 200+ fellow professionals and community of 1000+ from companies like Walmart, Allstate, Bain, Everlane, Macy's, Google, Vanguard, and more.

6. Brand Strategy Class by Mark Pollard

Mark Pollard is the CEO at Mighty Jungle and an author of this beginner level course on Skillshare. His approachable teaching style makes complex concepts accessible to newcomers.

A beginners course to building brands the strategic way.

In this short (and cheap) course you will learn the absolute basics of how to create a brand that can stand the test of time. It's the perfect starting point for anyone curious about brand strategy.

Cost: $32/m | Length: 1.5hours | By: Mark Pollard

This brand strategy course is probably the most basic and definitely the cheapest option from my list. The low barrier to entry makes it easy to test whether brand strategy interests you.

Mark breaks down every brand into three categories:

  • Product-centric
  • Customer-centric
  • Vision-centric

Next he presents you with frameworks to understand how brands can develop and thrive within each category. Understanding which category fits your brand helps focus your strategic efforts.

You'll be able to download a worksheet to follow along and learn how to develop a single-page brand strategy. This concise format forces clarity and eliminates fluff.

Whether you're a creative who wants to level up, or a business owner / entrepreneur this class will help you understand the fundamentals of brand building.

7. Introduction To Brand Strategy by Alejandro Pascalis

Alejandro Pascalis is a well-known brand strategist with over 10 years of experience and "Introduction to Brand Strategy" is his best-selling course. His practical approach has helped thousands of creatives add strategy to their toolkit.

A course that equips you with the tools to create comprehensive branding strategies.

This is a great brand strategy course for graphic designers, entrepreneurs, and anyone keen on mastering brand strategy, even if you don't have any previous experience. The course meets you where you are and builds from there.

Cost: $59.99 | Length: 2 hours 45 min | By: Alejandro Pascalis

It highlights the importance of understanding brand perception, user experience, and key brand elements like symbols and names. These fundamentals form the building blocks of any successful brand.

Pascalis focuses on users and brands, showing how strategic solutions benefit both. This dual focus ensures your strategy serves business goals while delighting customers.

You'll also gain hands-on experience through practical exercises like creating a brand name, designing a logo, and defining brand identity contact points in it. The exercises help cement theoretical concepts into practical skills.

By the end of this program, you will be proficient in crafting well-thought-out value propositions. You'll be able to articulate brand strategy with confidence to clients and stakeholders.

Overall, Introduction to Brand Strategy is a great course for you if you want to create effective branding strategies that add significant value to your clients.

8. Brand Strategy for Online Platforms by James Eccleston

James Eccleston is an experienced Brand and UX Specialist, and he shares practical branding strategies for digital platforms in the "Brand Strategy for Online Platforms" course. His expertise bridges the gap between traditional branding and digital user experience.

A great program that will help you master the art of developing a professional brand concept.

This brand strategy course is specifically designed for designers and design students who want to enhance their online branding skills. The digital focus is essential in 2026 when most brand interactions happen online.

Cost: $59.99 | Length: 2 hours 11 min | By: James Eccleston

The training covers various aspects of branding, including brand elements, online interpretation, and creating core values. You'll learn how traditional brand elements translate to digital contexts.

It provides insights into creating effective branding strategies for digital platforms. The course addresses the unique challenges and opportunities of building brands online.

There's also a practical section where you'll apply James's methodology to develop a professional online brand concept and implement it in webpage design. You'll leave with portfolio-ready work.

However, you need to have a basic understanding of graphic design and branding theory, along with proficiency in design software like Sketch, Adobe Illustrator, or Photoshop to fully benefit from this course. Figma skills are also valuable in 2026.

If you are looking for practical insights and hands-on experience to enhance your branding skills, then the Brand Strategy for Online Platforms is a great course for you.

9. Brand Strategy: Defining User Experience by John Williamson

John Williamson is a seasoned Designer and Creative Director and his course "Brand Strategy: Defining User Experience" shares his insights for creating engaging brands. His experience leading creative teams brings depth to every lesson.

John Williamson's course covering practical and user-focused theory.

This brand strategy course is designed for individuals interested in crafting compelling brands and exploring essential principles of brand strategy to establish strong brand identities. The user experience focus ensures your brand strategy translates to real-world interactions.

Cost: $59.99 | Length: 2 hours 52 min | By: John Williamson

This course provides a thorough exploration of branding basics for effective strategy execution. The fundamentals-first approach ensures you build on a solid foundation.

You will learn how to create an illustrated brand strategy using the seven steps of the Brand User Experience guide. The visual approach makes abstract concepts tangible and memorable.

Participants will also acquire valuable insights into crafting successful brands by the end of this course. You'll understand how strategy connects to every touchpoint in the user journey.

A great thing about this course is that you don't need any previous experience in branding strategy to get enrolled. It's designed to welcome absolute beginners.

Whether you are a designer or work in marketing, communications, or branding, Brand Strategy: Defining User Experience is a great course that will equip you with the essential skills for brand enhancement.

10. Client-Centered Brand Strategy by Thiago Delfino

Thiago Delfino is a brand Strategy Specialist and his course "Client-Centered Brand Strategy" covers how to develop a strategy that creates real bonds with customers. His client roster speaks to the effectiveness of his methods.

A course that teach you to understand consumers and develop strategies that build real relationships with brands.

Participants of this brand strategy course will learn to craft brand strategies from scratch by analyzing characteristics, identifying target audiences, and resolving brand-related challenges. The systematic approach ensures nothing is left to chance.

‍

Cost: $59.99 | Length: 1 hour 12 min | By: Thiago Delfino

This program is ideal for individuals who are interested in understanding and interpreting people to improve business positioning. Consumer psychology insights power the entire approach.

The course has 14 lessons covering topics including brand strategy foundations, analyzing brands, and understanding consumers. Each lesson builds logically on the previous one.

In addition to that, you also have the opportunity to learn from a brand strategist who has significantly contributed to the growth of major companies like Apple, Nike, and Coca-Cola. Learning from someone with this caliber of experience is invaluable.

You don't need any previous education or experience to get enrolled in this course. The course is designed to be accessible to all skill levels.

Client-Centered Brand Strategy is a great pick if you want advice from a brand strategy expert with a proven track record, whether you're new or experienced.

11. LEVEL C by Marty Neumeier

Marty Neumeier is also known as the grandfather of branding and his workshop Level C aims to elevate branding in the C-Suite also known as (CEO, CBO, CDO). His books like "The Brand Gap" have become required reading for anyone serious about branding.

A great course for anyone seeking to advance their career in branding and marketing.

The brand strategy course provides a comprehensive understanding of brand strategy, equipping participants with the tools needed to succeed in today's competitive market. The executive-level focus sets it apart from other courses on this list.

Cost: $2250 | Length: 2 days | By: Marty Neumeier

Additionally, the workshop is hands-on and in-person, allowing attendees to gain practical experience in modern brand-building techniques. The immersive format accelerates learning and builds lasting connections.

Participants of this program have the chance to network with industry leaders and peers, building valuable connections. The alumni network alone is worth the investment for many attendees.

They also receive a certification upon completing the course, which can greatly boost their branding career. The Level C credential is recognized and respected in the industry.

Many graduates of this masterclass have used this credential and leveled up into roles like Global Director of Marketing, Head of Brand, Head of Strategy, etc. The career impact can be substantial.

If you are someone who prefers to learn branding in a classroom environment and want to gain a valid certificate upon completion, Level C is a great program for you.

12. Brand Strategy by Chekitan Dev

Chekitan Dev is a professor at Cornell Nolan School of Hotel Administration and his course Brand Strategy focuses on optimizing brand strategy approaches in the market. His academic rigor combined with practical application makes for a powerful learning experience.

A great course that equips participants with clear strategies to capitalize on market positioning.

This is an ideal program for marketers, brand managers, PR and communications professionals, business leaders, executives, and entrepreneurs. The frameworks apply across industries and company sizes.

Cost: $999 | Length: 2 weeks| By: Chekitan Dev

Professor Chekitan Dev's course employs Porter's Five Forces model to pinpoint brand opportunities and threats. These classic strategic frameworks remain relevant in 2026 and provide a solid analytical foundation.

During the course, participants complete a Z-SWOT Matrix to align brand strengths and weaknesses with market opportunities and threats. This structured approach ensures comprehensive strategic analysis.

The course provides you with globally recognized credentials that will help you to further enhance your career opportunities. Cornell's reputation opens doors in any industry.

Additionally, participants of the course get to develop strategies to activate a brand they are familiar with. Working on a real brand makes the learning immediately applicable.

So, if you are looking to gain practical brand strategy skills with internationally recognized credentials, Brand Strategy is the ideal program for you.

13. Brand Master Academy

Don't get fooled by Brand Master Academy by Stephen Houraghan—I bought this course from the recommendation of Jacob Cass.

An overpriced course that doesn't provide any practical knowledge (and rebranded from Udemy).

Jacob essentially teamed up with Stephen to take his $9.99 Udemy course and rebrand it to make money off of unaware designers.

In this course, Stephen just paraphrases industry books, but the content is very chaotic and the author is all over the place (just check reviews on Udemy). The lack of original frameworks or methodologies is disappointing.

They just essentially teamed up to make money off of unaware designers—Jacob makes money as an affiliate, and Stephen profits from his large following. It's a cautionary tale about influencer recommendations.

When I complained about the course quality and asked for a refund, Jacob defamed me in the community and started spreading false narrative that I stole from Stephen.

Jacob is such a liar and a hypocrite that he even featured in his article my own proprietary framework (not Stephens) and he uses a version of my framework with his clients (and not Stephen's).

Also pay attention to the shady marketing tactics they use, e.g. the free social proof plugin that shows fake sales to make you feel like people buy this course—don't get fooled!

14. Brand Strategy by Cornell University

Cornell University offers a comprehensive online brand strategy course through their eCornell platform, designed to help professionals optimize their brand's market approach. The Ivy League pedigree brings additional credibility to your learning.

Cost: $999 | Length: 2 weeks | By: Chekitan Dev, Singapore Tourism Distinguished Professor

This course stands out for its structured approach to brand strategy analysis and implementation. The academic rigor combined with practical exercises creates a comprehensive learning experience.

Led by Professor Chekitan Dev from Cornell's Nolan School of Hotel Administration, the program focuses on practical frameworks and tools that professionals can immediately apply to real-world scenarios.

Key components:

  • Using Porter's Five Forces model to analyze market positioning
  • Completing a Z-SWOT matrix to align internal capabilities with market opportunities
  • Developing actionable brand strategies
  • Creating implementation plans for brand activation

The course requires 3-5 hours of work per week and is delivered in a 100% online, instructor-led format. The flexible schedule accommodates working professionals across time zones.

This makes it ideal for busy professionals who need flexibility while still wanting structured guidance.

15. Brand Revitalization by Harvard University

Harvard's Division of Continuing Education offers an intensive brand strategy course focused on brand revitalization in today's complex business environment, particularly addressing modern challenges like social activism and fragmented media landscapes.

Cost: $3,100 | Length: 2 consecutive days | By: Tessa Misiaszek & Matt Johnson

This high-level program stands out for its focus on contemporary brand challenges, particularly how brands can stay relevant in an era where consumers (especially Millennials and Gen Z) expect brands to take stands on social issues. In 2026, this expectation has only intensified.

The course is taught by two distinguished instructors: Tessa Misiaszek, Head of Research at Korn Ferry Institute, and Matt Johnson, PhD, a cognitive psychology expert from Princeton University.

Key components:

  • Understanding brand meaning and purpose in modern contexts
  • Developing brand communication strategies for fragmented media
  • Leveraging social psychology for brand loyalty
  • Navigating brand activism and social aspirations
  • Future-proofing brands in uncertain times

The course is delivered in an intensive on-campus format at Harvard University, combining case discussions, interactive exercises, and real-world scenario planning. The campus experience adds an invaluable networking dimension.

What sets this program apart is its strong emphasis on the social context of modern branding, particularly how brands must evolve to meet changing consumer expectations around social responsibility.

This course is best for:

  • Mid to senior-level professionals (minimum 5 years experience)
  • Marketing managers and directors
  • Brand managers and strategists
  • Product managers
  • Professionals interested in brand-society connections

The program's unique value lies in its contemporary focus and prestigious delivery.

Rather than just covering traditional brand strategy, it specifically addresses how brands can maintain relevance in an increasingly complex social and media environment.

Participants receive a Certificate of Completion from Harvard University's Division of Continuing Education, adding valuable credentials to their professional profile.

16. Product Design Strategy by Future London Academy

Future London Academy offers a strategic product design course led by Cal Thompson, VP of Product Design & Research at Headspace, focused on aligning design with business strategy.

Cost: £1,190 ($1,499) | Length: 5 hours self-paced | By: Cal Thompson

This course stands out for its practical focus on translating design vision into business impact. The senior practitioner perspective brings real-world credibility.

Led by a senior practitioner from Headspace with experience at Fjord/Accenture, it bridges the gap between design thinking and strategic decision-making.

Key components include:

  • Shaping product roadmaps and annual planning
  • Measuring design impact through appropriate metrics
  • Using primary research to influence executives
  • Future visioning and competitive analysis
  • Strategic frameworks for crowded markets

The course is delivered in 5 chapters of video content with accompanying exercises.

While shorter than some other options, it's intensively focused on practical application, including case studies from Headspace and Fjord.

Who this course is best for:

  • Heads of UX
  • Senior Product Designers
  • Product Design Leads
  • Designers seeking to influence product strategy

The program's unique value lies in its focus on the intersection of design and business strategy.

Rather than covering brand strategy broadly, it specifically addresses how designers can shape product roadmaps, measure impact, and influence stakeholders.

While not a traditional brand strategy course, its strategic approach to product design makes it valuable for brand professionals working in digital products.

17. Brand Strategy Academy by Sarah Robb

Price: $697 | Format: On-demand video course | Length: ~5 hours core + 8 hours advanced

Sarah Robb—known as Brand Strategy Sarah—brings over 20 years of experience leading strategy at top agencies like Landor, working with global brands including EY, Pepsi, Oracle, and Diageo. Her agency experience translates into practical, client-ready frameworks.

Her course offers a complete roadmap to help creatives confidently do and sell brand strategy, packed with client-tested frameworks, templates, and insights from real-world projects.

This course is best for:

Designers, copywriters, and marketers who want a practical, step-by-step system for delivering and selling brand strategy to clients.

It's especially valuable for freelancers and small studios looking to upgrade from design-only work to full strategic branding services.

Key components:

  • 7 structured modules with 20 video lessons
  • 18 downloadable templates and worksheets
  • Real-world case studies and 30+ brand examples
  • Exclusive Custom GPTs and prompts for strategists
  • Advanced masterclasses with experts in naming, brand architecture, and culture
  • Lifetime access, community membership (400+ members), and live Q&A sessions
  • 30-day money-back guarantee and flexible payment plan

Visit the course page

I just released my new app—an AI-powered brand strategy assistant. This tool represents the future of how strategists work in 2026 and beyond.

The tools is voice-enabled so that you can have a conversation with the A.I. like if you were talking to a real brand consultant.

The A.I. will walk you through my framework, suggest ideas, and once you approve them—it will fill out the slides for you!

Conclusions

A few voices who speak from experience and firsthand knowledge are infinitely more valuable than a multitude of voices that speak from theory and opinion. In 2026, with so much content available, this distinction matters more than ever.

This list features the most reputable and comprehensive brand strategy courses available online.

While neither theory nor opinion are bad in themselves, rarely do I find voices of value from sources that haven't been where I want to be. Seek out instructors who have actually done the work.

That's why on my list you will only find courses of authors that speak from true experience. Each course on this list represents hundreds or thousands of hours of real-world practice.

Please enjoy this collection of brand strategy courses and, more importantly — no matter which one you choose, implement it right away. Knowledge without application is just entertainment.

Remember, knowing and not doing is the same as not knowing. The best course is the one you actually complete and apply.

You need to make the mistakes, risk looking foolish, and invest in yourself and your business. Growth happens outside your comfort zone.

So whether you're a designer looking to level up and add strategy to your offering, or a business owner interested in building a strong brand — these courses are definitely worth checking out. The investment in learning pays dividends throughout your entire career.

This list includes everything you need to go out there and learn brand strategy. Pick one course and start today—your future clients will thank you.

Or actually without going out there — because you can enjoy these online classes from the comfort of your own home.
